facts.statement: The Back to School Bonanza let players redeem pre-paid game cards for Double Station Cash, with redemption open between September 2, 2011 and September 5, 2011.
facts.quote: redeem pre-paid game cards for Double Station Cash®*! ... between September 2, 2011, and September 5, 2011.

facts.statement: During the promotion, special sale items or activities were to appear in participating games, and details were on soe.com/backtoschool.
facts.quote: be on the lookout for special sale items or activities in participating games throughout the Back to School Bonanza

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This freerealms.com news post announces the Back to School Bonanza, a promotion where pre-paid game cards can be redeemed for Double Station Cash between September 2 and September 5, 2011, with special sale items or activities in participating games. The post is a short SOE-wide promotion notice rather than Free Realms-specific mechanics; the exact posting date is not shown (it reads as roughly one month before the 2011-09-30 capture).
